title: Framework Builder Passthroughs, App Commands Macro, Widget Extraction
description:
W0 mechanism-preparation wave for the Crate Consolidation & Plugin Taxonomy Restructure initiative (master ticket: .🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md). Add small, purely-additive framework APIs that W1/W2 plugin-migration waves will need to decompose monolithic UI Manifest builder-chains into per-node definition() functions:
1. AppBuilder passthroughs .mode_def(ModeDefinition) / .window_kind_def(WindowKindDefinition) / .panel_tab_def(PanelTabDefinition) in the os plugin SDK crate (🧰️framework/🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/🔌️plugin/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs), reusing the exact same internal storage as existing .mode()/.window_kind()/.panel_tab(). Ensure the three Definition structs are publicly constructible from outside the crate.
2. app_commands! macro (same crate) that declares a Command enum from "id" => module::Payload rows, expands to the enum + command_id() + a dispatch design, wire-compatible with existing hand-written Command enums' serde shape. Includes an inline #[cfg(test)] smoke test with fake payload modules.
3. Extract gizmo placement paint logic (♾️infinite/🌍️world) and minimap paint logic (dag board crate under ♾️infinite/🎲️board) into a new widgets region (gizmo/minimap submodules) in the wgpu ui crate (🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🖱️ui/🧊️wgpu/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs), pure code-motion, byte-identical behavior, original call sites become thin wrappers.
Nothing existing is removed or changed in behavior. Verification: cargo check/test on the plugin SDK crate (native + wasm32-wasip2), cargo check on wgpu ui crate and the infinite/world + dag board crates, workspace-wide or representative plugin checks, and `bun ./📜️script.ts verify gate`.
summary:
Completed all three W0 mechanism-preparation tasks, purely additive, zero existing behavior changed.

TASK 1 — AppBuilder passthroughs (semio-framework-plugin): added `.mode_def(ModeDefinition)`, `.window_kind_def(WindowKindDefinition)`, `.panel_tab_def(PanelTabDefinition)`. All three Definition structs were already publicly constructible (all fields `pub`, already imported into the `app` module) — no new constructors needed. Each converts the incoming Definition back into the existing builder-internal Spec type (`ModeSpec`/`WindowKindSpec`/`PanelTabSpec`) via new `mode_definition_to_spec`/`window_kind_definition_to_spec`/`panel_tab_definition_to_spec` helpers, then pushes into the SAME `self.modes`/`self.window_kinds`/`self.panel_tabs` vectors the scalar-arg `.mode()`/`.window_kind()`/`.panel_tab()` methods already populate — so `build_definition()`'s validation runs unchanged regardless of entry path. `WindowKindSpec` gained 5 new fields (`params_schema`/`document_projection_schema`/`input_event_schema`/`output_schema`/`capabilities`) so a full `WindowKindDefinition` round-trips losslessly; the two scalar constructors default them to None/empty (matching prior hardcoded behavior exactly — zero regression).

TASK 2 — app_commands! macro (semio-framework-plugin, macro_rules!, no proc-macro infra existed): `app_commands! { pub enum Name for Projection, Operation, Config, ConfigOperation { "id" => module::Payload, .. } }` expands to the enum (one single-field tuple variant per row, deriving Clone/Debug/PartialEq/serde/dsl::DslOps with `#[dsl(key = "id")]` — matching every hand-written Command enum's exact derive/attribute shape, e.g. flow_protocol::FlowCommand; dsl::DslOps's single-field-tuple-variant codegen delegates entirely to the payload's own DslField impl so wire bytes are unaffected by the inline-fields-to-payload-struct migration), `command_id(&self) -> &'static str`, and a CONCRETE (non-generic) `dispatch(&self, doc, cfg) -> Result<Emit<Operation, ConfigOperation>, Fault>` matching each variant to `module::handle(payload, doc, cfg)`. Design note: a first attempt made `dispatch<P,O,C,CO>` fully generic; this does NOT type-check against concrete-typed real payload handlers (proven by the smoke test itself hitting exactly this mismatch) — the macro now takes the app's four DocumentApp associated types as invocation-time `for` clause instead, documented in a `🔖️DispatchDesignChoice` doc comment. Smoke test (`app_commands_tests` mod, 3 tests, 2 fake payload modules) passes: `cargo test -p semio-framework-plugin app_commands` — command_id, dispatch-forwarding, and dsl::DslOps OpText/OpBinary round-trip via `store::test_support::assert_op_text_binary_equivalence`.

TASK 3 — widget extraction: (a) Gizmo — moved `spatial_axis_rgba`/`orbit_view_gizmo_placement`/`OrbitViewGizmoTip`/`orbit_view_gizmo_tips`/`orbit_view_gizmo_hit_test`/`paint_orbit_view_gizmo` verbatim from ♾️infinite/🌍️world into `ui_wgpu::widgets::gizmo` (all 6 call sites were confined to one file, confirmed by repo-wide grep, so fully relocated — not a wrapper). ♾️infinite/🌍️world keeps only `update_world_orbit_view_gizmo_hover` (World3dState-specific hover plumbing), now calling `gizmo::*`. (b) Minimap — DEVIATED from literally nesting inside ui_wgpu::widgets after investigation: the dag board's minimap PAINT (`paint_minimap_widget`) is irreducibly `vello::Scene`(via infinite_canvas)-specific and DAG-node-type-specific, a completely different rendering pipeline from ui_wgpu's wgpu/WidgetContext engine (confirmed dag board has zero prior ui_wgpu dependency). Forcing it into ui_wgpu's engine-gated `widgets` mod would force a heavy wgpu/winit/kernel_3d_scene dependency onto a lightweight vello-based crate for no benefit. Instead extracted the fully backend-agnostic PURE GEOMETRY (content-bounds-visibility check, panel/viewport layout math, screen<->world mapping, point-in-rect) as a new NON-engine-gated `ui_wgpu::minimap` module (sibling to the existing `geometry` module, not nested in the engine-gated `widgets` — so consumers pull it in via ui_wgpu's lightweight default features only). Added a plain `ui_wgpu` (default features) dependency to the dag board Cargo.toml; its 4 pure layout methods became thin wrappers calling `ui_wgpu::minimap::*`; `paint_minimap_widget` (vello calls) is untouched. Proven byte-identical: all 117 dag board tests pass, including the 4 minimap-specific ones (`minimap_widget_paints_without_panic`, `minimap_widget_click_repositions_camera`, `minimap_widget_label_overlay_includes_rect_when_visible`, `dag_host_minimap_bounded_drag_moves_selection_inside_union_bounds`).
